The function Services_1_FindProvider only returns providers; it doesn't check availability. There's no function to check availability. So we cannot directly check availability. We can call FindProvider to get providers in Walnut Creek, CA. Then we can ask the user if they want to book an appointment. We can respond that we can find providers but we can't confirm availability. We can provide a list of stylists. Then ask if they'd like to book. Or we can ask them to specify a stylist.
